name: Regency Fincorp Ltd
title: Regency Fincorp Ltd - 540175 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Small North India NBFC pivoting from JLG/unsecured to secured MSME lending; AUM up 45% to INR261.2 cr, but net NPA rose to 0.74% from 0.31% and cost of funds is 13-14%, with no supply-side or capacity signal.

triggers.label: JLG book run-down, no new JLG disbursement since Nov
triggers.quote: We have not done a single penny disbursement from the month of November onwards

triggers.label: Net NPA 0.31% → 0.74%
triggers.quote: our net NPA stood at 0.74% in FY2026, compared to 0.31% FY2025

triggers.label: Cost of funds 13-14% → 11-12% target
triggers.quote: We want to take down so between 11% to 12%

guidance.quote: We want to take down so between 11% to 12%
Have a branch spread of about close to 50 branches by the year-end financial year end next year
By end of the next calendar year, the 100% JLG book would be zero

red_flags.label: Net NPA nearly 2.4x YoY (0.31% to 0.74%)
red_flags.quote: our net NPA stood at 0.74% in FY2026, compared to 0.31% FY2025

red_flags.label: Management conceded NPA rise tied to JLG stress
red_flags.quote: there was a bit NPA that rose in our book as well, which is witnessed in our balance sheet as well

red_flags.label: Aggressive AUM and branch target from small base
red_flags.quote: we should touch our INR3000 crores of golden AUM number

red_flags.label: CRAR fall and NPA questioned by analyst; answer vague
red_flags.quote: Keeping that context in mind is then when this second financial year onwards

evasions.quote: Keeping that context in mind is then when this second financial year onwards, so the half year onwards after the September meet
So, 8% while I may not want to comment right now, but Yes, we will have significant reduce on the cost of funds.
